title: cargo build picks the GPU backend by itself
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. build.rs detects nvcc/CUDA or Metal and enables the matching feature, so build-gpu.sh and the CPU-only warning are unnecessary. Tests zc_gpu_build_auto_* for the detection logic.
